info.name: Komute-Local API
info.description:
Driver and vehicle verification node. Read postman/README.md first.

Set the Postman working directory to the repo's postman folder so the sample images load. All sample data is fake.

exec: // A fresh request_id for every request; replay requests use {{savedRid}} instead.

item.name: 1. Health and monitoring
item.description: Read-only endpoints. They never change state.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 (503 means a required model failed to load)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description: Liveness probe for the host or load balancer. 200 = ready, 503 = degraded.

exec: pm.test("has live sample, models and engine state", () => { pm.expect(body.sample.memory.process_rss_mb).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(body.models).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(body.engine).to.have.property("busy"); });

request.description: Data behind the /stats dashboard. Needs X-API-Key when authentication is on.

exec: pm.test("returns the HTML dashboard", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type")).to.include("text/html"); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include("Komute System Monitor"); });

request.description: A browser gets the dashboard page; open {{baseUrl}}/v1/system in a browser to see it live.

item.name: 2. Verify: main flow
item.description: POST /v1/verify with the fake licence. The barcode stage passes; the selfie has no face, so the result is REJECTED with the retryable FACE_NOT_FOUND_SELFIE. That proves Stage 1 end to end without real personal data.

exec: pm.test("barcode stage ran and every licence rule passed", () => { const b = body.stages.barcode; pm.expect(b.ran && b.readable && b.aamva).to.be.true; pm.expect(b.jurisdiction).to.eql("ON"); pm.expect(b.gates_failed).to.eql([]); });
pm.test("7 fields cross-checked, all matched", () => { const c = body.stages.barcode.checks; pm.expect(c).to.have.length(7); c.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.passed, r.field).to.be.true); });
pm.test("reasons include FACE_NOT_FOUND_SELFIE", () => { const c = body.reasons.map(r => r.code); ["FACE_NOT_FOUND_SELFIE"].forEach(x => pm.expect(c).to.include(x)); });
pm.test("full barcode fields only if the node enables them", () => { if (body.barcode_fields) pm.expect(body.barcode_fields.DAQ).to.eql("T12345678901234"); });
// keep this request for the idempotency folder

request.description: Main happy path for Stage 1. Saves its request_id for the next folder.

item.name: 3. Idempotency and stored results
item.description: Uses the request_id saved by folder 2. Run folder 2 first.

request.description: The node does not re-run a verification it already decided.

item.name: 4. Stage 1 cross-checks
item.description: Each request changes one claimed field. A mismatch is a final reason code; Stages 2 and 3 do not run.

exec: pm.test("reasons include CLASS_MISMATCH", () => { const c = body.reasons.map(r => r.code); ["CLASS_MISMATCH"].forEach(x => pm.expect(c).to.include(x)); });

pm.test("check row licence_class fails", () => { const row = body.stages.barcode.checks.find(c => c.field === "licence_class"); pm.expect(row, "row present").to.be.an("object"); pm.expect(row.passed).to.eql(false); });

item.name: 5. Barcode problems
item.description: What the driver sees when the barcode photo is bad.

exec: pm.test("reasons include BARCODE_UNREADABLE", () => { const c = body.reasons.map(r => r.code); ["BARCODE_UNREADABLE"].forEach(x => pm.expect(c).to.include(x)); });

pm.test("retryable, with the retake message", () => { const r = body.reasons.find(x => x.code === "BARCODE_UNREADABLE"); pm.expect(r.retryable).to.be.true; pm.expect(r.message).to.include("not clearly visible"); });

request.description: The licence back is a plain image, so no PDF417 is found.

item.name: 6. Input validation (422)
item.description: Bad requests return 422 with a specific code and never a decision.

item.name: 7. Authentication
item.description: Authentication is OFF by default. Start the node with .\run.ps1 -WithApiKey, put the key from %LOCALAPPDATA%\komute\dev.env in the environment's apiKey, and set authEnabled to true.

exec: pm.test("auth is off: the key is ignored (HTTP 200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("auth is off: no key needed (HTTP 200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("auth is off: verification runs (HTTP 200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
